records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/camayoc/docs%2Fdesign%2Fcertified-knowledge-packs.md

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/camayoc/docs%2Freference.md

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/camayoc/scripts%2Fjev_mcp.py
records.summary: The stdio MCP adapter delegates typed decisions to the existing Jev client; a missing key is a tool error and dry-run sends no provider request.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/camayoc/docs%2Freleases.md
records.summary: Stable tags publish the tracked source archive, checksum and source.json; source releases contain no native Camayoc executable.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/camayoc/docs%2Fdesign%2Fcertified-knowledge-packs.md
records.summary: Use the existing governed distribution artifact and canonical graph hash; upload location is a copy, integrity is not certification, and import does not imply promotion.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/camayoc/docs%2Fwhy-camayoc.md
records.summary: Start with the ownership boundary between ontology, ingress, storage and retrieval.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/camayoc/docs%2Freference.md
